focus: what decides whether an installed plugin ever updates
method: replicated a profile at 0.1.3, then ran the bundled pnpm's update under three spec forms; the cooldown was simulated by passing --config.minimum-release-age=0 instead of waiting for real maturity

results.reading: an exact pin never moves: pnpm update will not exceed it, so this install is frozen until something rewrites the spec
with the window out of the way the caret range moves to the highest published version that is mature at that instant (0.1.10 was still inside its own window)
no version inside the window qualifies, so it stays put — the behaviour documented earlier

whoWritesWhichSpec.market one-click install: x.y.z (exact, measured separately in docs/e2e/market-install-flow.json) — updates come from the market's own update action, not from a plain pnpm update

predictionForTheDailyProfile: it carries ^0.1.3, so it moves on its own once a version matures: 0.1.4 at 22:42, and it will keep stepping forward as later versions pass their windows
whyThisMatters: an author who installs their own release with an exact version sees no updates and can conclude the release pipeline is broken, when the spec is the cause
